title: doellingeria umbellata var. latifolia
intro: Doellingeria umbellata var. latifolia, commonly known as the broad-leaved false goldenrod, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and aid in the removal of toxins from the body. The bioactive constituents of Doellingeria umbellata var. latifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
